text:
Elena M: Quick follow-up from the cache-thrash postmortem. We promised remediation + tests: nightly regression harness, incident-derived promptset, a CI cold-load smoke, and a 30-min chaos drill. Need owners + firm dates.
Ravi K: I can own the regression harness. Plan: nightly 6m cold-cache run that exercises TTL boundaries and long-tail reads. Will add a daily gate and a ticket-creator when it fails. Target PR by Wed EOD.
Hannah J: Ill curate the promptset from incident transcripts. Deliverable: 14 prompts (critical path + edge cases) with golden outputs and a scoring rubric. ETA next Monday.
ci-bot: Please tag CI runs with env=staging-inference and metrics_namespace=kv.cache.
Elena M: We should include an automatic gate: if eviction_rate > 0.025 for two consecutive nightly runs, create an incident ticket and @oncall.
Ravi K: Sounds good. Proposed check: run 60k-key workload, compute eviction_rate, fail if >0.025. Also assert p95 latency < baseline*1.3.
Hannah J: For scoring promptset, propose two tiers: critical prompts require exact match; tolerance tier uses ROUGE-L >= 0.65. Ill document examples and expected JSON.
ci-bot: Draft CI job snippet to add to infra/.github/workflows:
```yaml
jobs:
  kv_cold_smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: ./tests/kv_cold_load.sh --keys 60000 --duration 360
      - run: ./tests/metrics_check.sh --metric kv.cache.eviction_rate --threshold 0.025
```
Elena M: Chaos drill scope: simulate regional capacity pressure -> trigger routing fallback -> validate degraded-quality alarms -> practice canary model swap to smaller variant -> rollback. Make the playbook 30min and include rollback steps.
Ravi K: Ill add the daily gate + the failover verification into regression job and link PR here.
Hannah J: Ill include the truncation + hallucination examples and a small eval script that outputs pass/fail per prompt.
ops-bot: Drill scheduled: "cache-thrash remediation drill" on 2026-04-10 16:00 UTC. Participants: Elena M, Ravi K, Hannah J, oncall.
Elena M: Action list from thread:
- Ravi: nightly regression harness + gate + auto-ticket (PR Wed EOD)
- Hannah: promptset + golden outputs + scoring script (PR Mon)
- Elena: update staging rollout policy to ensure automatic fallback & canary swap enabled
Please paste PR links here when opened. Well have a 20-min sync Friday 9am PT to validate integrations before the drill. If anything slips, escalate in-thread. :eyes:
